name: orchestrator
description: Macro orchestration capability — multi-deliverable plan + Plan-verify ensemble + same-host dispatch into engineer for AI-assisted development across Claude Code & Codex CLI. L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition (ADR-0018 §sub-decision-1, ADR-0019 cross-plugin invocation).

interface.shortDescription: Macro orchestration — multi-deliverable plan + Plan-verify ensemble + same-host dispatch
interface.longDescription: L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition + ADR-0018 §sub-decision-1 + ADR-0019 cross-plugin invocation contract. First multi-verb L2 occupant (single-verb capability precedent ADR-0010 §3 does not apply). Provides /orchestrator:plan (macro plan + Plan-verify Codex ensemble), /orchestrator:next (same-host dispatch into engineer with branch precondition + parent-linkage env vars), /orchestrator:done (idempotent backup for engineer Stop auto-writeback). Single Responsibility: orchestration only; cognitive activity (single-deliverable thought) remains engineer's responsibility. Workflow files at <repo>/.claude/agentic-orchestrator/workflows/ with schema '1.1' (distinct from engineer's schema '1.1' by structural validation — orchestrator requires workflow_type=macro + plan.subtasks[]). /orchestrator:finalize + /orchestrator:abort + macro Stop auto-archive land in PR-E. Cross-host --peer dispatch lands in PR-F.
defaultPrompt: $orchestrator:plan Implement schema 1.1 → 1.2 reader/writer migration as a multi-deliverable feature
